credits.title: Minotaur
credits.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

credits.title: The Disappearance of Josef Mengele
credits.overview: In the aftermath of the Second World War, Josef Mengele, the Nazi doctor at Auschwitz, escapes to South America to rebuild his life in hiding. credits.title: Cargo
credits.overview: A young Russian woman, smuggled into America by human traffickers, and a notorious Egyptian transporter hired to drive her from the Mexican border to New York City, form an unlikely bond that transforms them and threatens to derail the traffickers' plans.

credits.title: Saints and Sinners
credits.overview: This documentary explores the social, political and religious aspects of same-sex marriage and examines its effect on American society.
